title: Consolidate IncarnationError ⇄ ProxyError
finding: IncarnationError (pub(crate), domain/incarnation.rs) and ProxyError (pub, adapter/proxy.rs) had identical variant sets {AlreadyInitialized, AttemptSequenceExhausted} and a 1:1 From bridge. Incarnation has exactly one consumer (Proxy), so the adapter split carried zero decoupling value.
change: Made IncarnationError pub; deleted adapter ProxyError + From bridge; Proxy::Error = IncarnationError; re-exported as `pub use domain::{IncarnationError as ProxyError}` preserving the documented facade name.
falsifier: Consolidation weakens static meaning (rejected: single consumer, verbatim-identical variants).
verification: cargo build + 280 nextest pass; clippy clean; public name ProxyError preserved via alias.
notes: If a second Incarnation consumer appears, the public/domain error split regains justification; revisit.

title: Split BreakerOutcome::Admitted{probe:bool}
finding: BreakerOutcome::Admitted { attempt, probe: bool } re-encoded the Closed-vs-Probing phase distinction as a boolean; field had no doc and no consumer read it.
change: Split into Admitted { attempt } (closed) and ProbeAdmitted { attempt } (half-open recovery probe) with docs; updated two construction sites and the test admit helper.
falsifier: The two admission kinds are semantically identical (rejected: probe admission is a distinct single-flight recovery semantics).
verification: 128 actors tests + 280 workspace tests pass; clippy clean; fmt clean.
notes: Public API break: consumers matching Admitted{attempt,probe} must match ProbeAdmitted separately.

title: Remove unwrap_or(u32::MAX) sentinel in RestartBudget
finding: RestartBudget stored maximum as usize then did maximum.try_into().unwrap_or(u32::MAX) for the error field; the fallback was dead (maximum provably <= u32::MAX) and would report a lying maximum_restarts if ever hit.
change: Stored maximum as u32 directly; comparison uses lossless `as usize`; error field uses self.maximum unchanged.
falsifier: u32->usize conversion can lose precision (rejected: usize >= 32 bits on all supported platforms).
notes: Duration::MAX window check is a pure optimization over a legitimately-large value (age <= Duration::MAX always), not a 'none' sentinel; left unchanged.

title: IncarnationEffects 3-Option -> enum
finding: IncarnationEffects{N,C,M} held creation/delivery/creation_report as three Options encoding a 4-way exclusive choice (8 representable, 4 reachable); its doc claimed independence that actually lives in IncarnationStopEffects.
change: Converted to enum {None,Create,Deliver{incarnation,message},Report}; refactored begin() to return IncarnationCreation (dropping phantom M); updated forward/replace/child_stopped and proxy consumption.
falsifier: creation+report can co-occur (rejected: they never do; that case is IncarnationStopEffects).
verification: 128 actors + 280 workspace tests pass; clippy clean; fmt clean.
notes: IncarnationStopEffects kept as 2-Option product: creation and stopped are genuinely independent.

title: Add From/Into/TryFrom to u64 newtypes
finding: 12 u64-backed newtypes (JobId, AssignmentId, BreakerAttempt, Sequence, BarrierGeneration, ConfigurationVersion, LoadVersion, Load, MemberToken, MemberTokenVersion, ObservationVersion, PresenceVersion) lacked the From<u64>/From<X> for u64 impls that MailAddr/TimerId/TimerGeneration already had; TokenCount(NonZeroU64) had only new/get.
change: Added From<u64> + From<X> for u64 to all 12; added TryFrom<u64> (reject 0) + From<TokenCount> for u64 to TokenCount, matching the existing convention.
falsifier: From<u64> erases stream authority (rejected: it only permits primitive<->newtype, never newtype<->newtype).
verification: 280 workspace tests pass; clippy clean; fmt clean.
notes: Call sites still construct via X(v)/.0; the impls complete the surface for .into()/.try_into() consumers and unify the convention.

lens: invalid representable states / forgeable public obligations
title: Make report/state snapshot types unforgeable
finding: Four public value types had pub fields whose aggregate contradicts their collection: HealthReport.overall (derived worst), ReadinessReport.ready (derived all-ready), DeduplicatorState.retained (len<=capacity), WorkQueueState.available/queued (queued<=capacity). DeduplicatorState/WorkQueueState also violated the crate convention (CacheState/BufferState keep collections private).
change: HealthReport.overall and ReadinessReport.ready became derived methods; DeduplicatorState.retained and WorkQueueState.available/queued became private with accessors. Updated all consumers (tests + testkit).
falsifier: The derived/collection fields are genuine independent data (rejected: each is a pure function of the sibling collection, and the convention is already private-collections).
verification: 280 workspace tests + 10 doc tests pass; clippy clean; fmt clean.
notes: HealthReport/ReadinessReport are wire types; DeduplicatorState/WorkQueueState are introspection snapshots.

title: Extend forgeable-state fix to RateLimiterState and OrderGateState
finding: The adversarial scout's 'collections private' heuristic missed two derived-count states: RateLimiterState.available (<= capacity) and OrderGateState.held (= retained-map size), both pub and forgeable.
change: RateLimiterState.available and OrderGateState.held became private with accessors; updated consumers (tests + testkit catalogue_models).
falsifier: The counts are independent data (rejected: each is a pure function of the owning behavior's internal collection/capacity).
verification: 280 workspace tests pass; clippy clean; fmt clean.

lens: documentation claims not connected to behavior
title: Truthful doc/allow-reason fixes
finding: Buffer rustdoc had a stray 'No' fragment; Supervisor::new's #[allow(too_many_arguments)] reason claimed 'hidden by Compose' but it is pub and re-exported.
change: Removed the stray fragment; rewrote the allow-reason and doc to state the builder path truthfully.
falsifier: The constructor is genuinely hidden (rejected: pub + re-exported).
verification: nix flake check 9/9 pass; 280 tests; doc tests pass.

title: mem::take instead of drain().collect() in Machine/Stash
finding: machine.rs drain() and stash.rs drain_into() did self.held.drain(..).collect() on the hot transition path: this frees the old buffer while allocating a fresh VecDeque and moving every element, doubling peak capacity.
change: Replaced with core::mem::take(&mut self.held), reusing the existing buffer with zero allocation or moves.
falsifier: re-merge semantics differ (rejected: mem::take leaves an equivalent empty deque; re-merge via extend/drain is identical).

title: circuit_breaker dead unwrap_or and TimerGeneration(0) dummy
finding: admit() had next.unwrap_or(self.next_attempt) inside is_some guards (dead fallback); complete() carried (probe:bool, TimerGeneration(0)) where the generation was a dummy when !probe.
change: unwrap_or -> expect (guard proves Some); ownership tuple (probe, generation) -> Option<TimerGeneration> so probe is derivable and the dummy is gone.
falsifier: probe and generation are independent (rejected: generation only meaningful when probe, exactly Option).

title: circuit_breaker Exhausted boundary tests
finding: Both documented exhaustion boundaries (attempt counter, timer generation) were untested, unlike every sibling template (Sequencer/Presence/Lease/Barrier/PriorityQueue).
change: Added two field-injection tests driving next_attempt=u64::MAX and ProbePhase with generation=u64::MAX, asserting Exhausted phase + Rejected(Exhausted).
falsifier: boundary unreachable in production (rejected: reachable via 2^64 operations; parity with siblings requires the test).

title: supervisor wrap() intermediate born Vec
finding: wrap() materialized a Vec of Copy nonces, then re-iterated to build ObserveChild.
change: Build ObserveChild directly from actions.creates.iter() before into_iter() consumes it.
falsifier: two-pass ordering required (rejected: fleet.register and ObserveChild both read nonce independently).

title: deny.toml stale license entries
finding: [[licenses.clarify]] ring block (ring absent from Cargo.lock; expression names OpenSSL not in allow) plus stale comments citing arrayref/blake3/crc32c/varint-rs/lsm-tree/fjall (all absent); allow list had 7 licenses no dependency uses.
change: Removed the dead ring block and stale comments; trimmed allow list to the 4 licenses actually in Cargo.lock (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, Unicode-3.0).
falsifier: removing needed allowances (rejected: cargo deny check licenses passes clean).
verification: cargo deny check licenses: ok, 0 warnings.

title: Revert E05 convenience conversion surface
finding: E05 explicitly reported zero call-site use and justified 26 public conversion impls only by uniformity. AGENTS.md forbids convenience constructors without demonstrated semantic value and requires abstractions to have concrete use.
change: Removed E05's From<u64>, From<X> for u64, and TokenCount TryFrom/From impls; retained pre-existing TimerId/TimerGeneration and address conversions required by concrete protocol bounds.
falsifier: A current composition requires one of the new conversion bounds (rejected: workspace search found no consumer and pinned all-target checking passed after removal).
verification: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, and 10 doc tests pass in the pinned Nix environment.

title: Direct activation and wrapper-only Compose trait
finding: Compose<B> was mandatory even for standalone catalogue templates and mixed three authorities: consuming initialization, wrapper transformations, and Supervisor policy configuration. Compose::new was an identity container around already-concrete Behavior values.
change: Replaced the container with blanket Activate and Compose extension traits. Activate consumes any concrete Behavior into Initialized/Active. Compose contains only wrapper transformations. Catalogue constructors remain direct; Supervisor policy uses its owning with_* methods; all callers and test/fuzz model types were migrated.
falsifier: Direct activation weakens one-time initialization or wrapper composition loses lanes (pending full compile-fail, composition, property, fuzz-build, and Nix verification).
verification: cargo check --workspace --all-targets passes; full gates pending.
lines: public API break: Compose<B>/Compose::new removed; Activate added

title: Verify direct activation and inferred wrapper stacks
finding: The new surface retains one-time activation, typed wrapper composition, initialization ordering, and complete effect lanes. The standalone fuzz crate initially exposed missing Activate/Compose imports and two tuple artifacts; those migration defects were corrected.
change: Added explicit extension-trait imports to fuzz targets, removed tuple artifacts, taught the architecture gate that Compose is a zero-generic trait, and ratcheted the reviewed Activate/IncarnationError surface.
falsifier: Any workspace, compile-fail, composition, fuzz-build, architecture, dependency, audit, formatting, or Nix check fails.
verification: focused strict Clippy passes; nextest 282/282; doctests 10/10; fuzz manifest all-target build passes; architecture review resolves 67/67 obligations and 53/53 capabilities; all six nix flake checks pass; cargo-fuzz execution unavailable because cargo-fuzz is not installed in the pinned shell.
lines: Compose<B> and Compose::new remain absent; normal nested construction is inferred
